description: This is a Java test class for testing loan transactions in the Apache Fineract project. It extends a base test class and uses JUnit 5 annotations to define multiple test cases for loan transaction API functionalities, including filtering, template retrieval, and specific transaction types like capitalized income and buy-down fees.

classes.name: LoanTransactionTest
classes.description: Test class for loan transaction functionalities in the Fineract project.

methods.name: testGetLoanTransactionsFiltering
methods.description: Tests filtering of loan transactions by date and type, including external ID filtering.

methods.name: testGetLoanTransactionTemplateForCapitalizedIncomeWithOverAppliedAmount
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a transaction template for capitalized income when over-applied amounts are involved.

methods.name: testGetLoanTransactionTemplateForCapitalizedIncomeWithoutOverAppliedAmount
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a transaction template for capitalized income without over-applied amounts.

methods.name: testGetLoanTransactionTemplateForCapitalizedIncomeAdjustment
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a transaction template for capitalized income adjustment transactions.

methods.name: testGetLoanTransactionTemplateForBuyDownFeeAdjustment
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a transaction template for buy-down fee adjustments.

methods.name: testGetLoanTransactionTemplateForBuyDownFee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a transaction template for buy-down fees.
